summary: Converts three Euler angles in a1[0..2] into a quaternion written to a2[0..3] using the half-angle trigonometric construction. Computes cos/sin of each half angle, forms the four cos/sin cross products, and combines them into the w/x/y/z quaternion components. Marked by cluster_copy as a structural twin of EulerAnglesToQuaternion (0050dd40, DERIVED). Called by CollisionResponseFilter (004584c0) and AudioSampleCrossFadeInterpolation (004ff8f0).

local_names.a1[0]: first Euler angle (half-angle 0.5*angle used in cos/sin)
local_names.a2: output quaternion (w at a2[0], x at a2[1], y at a2[2], z at a2[3])
local_names.v11: copy of the sin3*sin2 product term

operations.description: Half-angle trig of the first Euler angle: v2 = cos(a1[0]*0.5), v3 = sin(a1[0]*0.5)
Half-angle trig of the second Euler angle: v4 = a1[1]*0.5, v5 = cos(v4), v6 = sin(v4)
Half-angle trig of the third Euler angle: v7 = a1[2]*0.5, v12 = cos(v7), v14 = sin(v7)
Form the cos/sin cross products: v10 = v12*v5, v8 = v14*v6, v11 = v8, v13 = v12*v6, v9 = v5*v14
Compose quaternion components: a2[0] = v8*v3 + v10*v2, a2[1] = v10*v3 + v11*v2
Compose quaternion components: a2[2] = v13*v2 - v9*v3, a2[3] = v9*v2 - v13*v3
